classification.difficultyReason: Use the cosine rule to obtain angles from three sides, then complete each triangle using the angle sum and, where applicable, equal angles opposite equal sides.

content.prompt: Find all angles. Give answers correct to one decimal place.

spec.description: Triangle with C upper left, A upper right and B lower left; ordinary source-blue strokes rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: AC = 10 cm, BC = 9 cm, AB = 14 cm. No supplied angle values or right-angle marks.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; all angles remain unknown.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}9^2&=10^2+14^2-2(10)(14)\cos A\\\cos A&=\frac{10^2+14^2-9^2}{2(10)(14)}\\\cos A&=\frac{43}{56}\\A&\approx39.8^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\cos B&=\frac{9^2+14^2-10^2}{2(9)(14)}\\\cos B&=\frac{59}{84}\\B&\approx45.4^\circ\end{align*}$$

Using the angle sum of a triangle, with unrounded angles:

$$\begin{align*}C&=180^\circ-A-B\\C&\approx94.8^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Isosceles triangle with A upper left, C below and to its right, and B at right. Matching single ticks on AC and BC; ordinary strokes rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: AB = 14 cm and AC = BC = 8 cm.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}14^2&=8^2+8^2-2(8)(8)\cos C\\\cos C&=\frac{8^2+8^2-14^2}{2(8)(8)}\\\cos C&=-\frac{17}{32}\\C&\approx122.1^\circ\end{align*}$$

Since $AC=BC$, the opposite angles are equal: $A=B$. Using the unrounded value of $C$:

$$\begin{align*}A=B&=\frac{180^\circ-C}{2}\\A=B&\approx29.0^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with A at top, C below and slightly left, and B lower right; ordinary source-blue strokes rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: AC = 8 cm, BC = 9 cm, AB = 16 cm. No supplied angle values.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; all angles remain unknown.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}9^2&=8^2+16^2-2(8)(16)\cos A\\\cos A&=\frac{8^2+16^2-9^2}{2(8)(16)}\\\cos A&=\frac{239}{256}\\A&\approx21.0^\circ\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\cos B&=\frac{9^2+16^2-8^2}{2(9)(16)}\\\cos B&=\frac{91}{96}\\B&\approx18.6^\circ\end{align*}$$

Using the angle sum of a triangle, with unrounded angles:

$$\begin{align*}C&=180^\circ-A-B\\C&\approx140.4^\circ\end{align*}$$
